SELECT CHOOSE(2, 'Red', 'Green', 'Blue') AS PickedColor;

caption: index, then the list of candidate values.

eyebrow: Mapping a numeric status code to a label
code:
SELECT SalesOrderID, Status,
  CHOOSE(Status, 'In Process', 'Approved', 'Backordered',
                 'Rejected', 'Shipped', 'Cancelled') AS StatusLabel
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader;
caption: Status used directly as the index into the label list.

eyebrow: Out of range: NULL, not an error
code:
SELECT CHOOSE(10, 'Red', 'Green', 'Blue') AS OutOfRange;
-- Returns NULL -- there's no 10th item
caption: No exception -- CHOOSE just returns NULL past the end of the list.
